slices.description: The 25 open roadmap features to allocate: state, epic, WSJF/RICE, spec path, plus recorded sequencing/blocking facts.
Per-host capability, current load and constraint evidence for ARIELLAS, OLAMNIT and GAVRIELLA: declared scheduler caps, scheduler cards, coop status files.

Protocol and tooling constraints the design must satisfy: coop CRDT protocol v2, scheduler CPM/PERT contract, pipeline stage order, marathon advisory semantics, safe-restart and sync-round obligations, known fleet traps.
